label: Handheld X-Ray
tagline: Point-of-care radiography in a sub-4 kg body.
description: Ultra-portable ERAY SMART HS handheld X-ray units for TB screening, NICUs, disaster sites, outreach camps and home care — battery powered and ready wherever the patient is.

label: Mobile X-Ray
tagline: Imaging that comes to the bedside.
description: The ERAY SMART series of high-frequency digital mobile X-ray systems for human and veterinary use — compact, lightweight and paired with wireless flat panel detectors for wards, critical care units and operating rooms.

label: Fixed X-Ray
description: ERAY RAD and ERAY SMART ECO DR high-frequency fixed X-ray systems — anatomical programming, rapid patient positioning and wireless flat panel detectors for hospitals, institutions and diagnostic centres.

label: Surgical C-Arms
tagline: Flat panel fluoroscopy for the operating room.
description: ERAY Smart 5C mobile C-Arms for orthopaedics, trauma, neurosurgery, spine surgery, gastroenterology and urology — high image quality at low dose, with DICOM 3.0 integration.

label: DR Detectors
tagline: Wireless DR, without the cost barrier.
description: ERAY and TRIMAX flat panel detectors that bring wireless digital radiography to new rooms, mobile systems and retrofits of existing X-ray equipment.

label: CR Systems
tagline: The practical route from film to digital.
description: Compact TRIMAX and ERAY computed radiography readers for small-to-medium hospitals, clinics and practices that need in-house digital imaging at an accessible price.

label: Medical Printers
description: TRIMAX dry laser imagers, the ERAY thermal dry imager and ERAY inkjet printing — reliable diagnostic film output for CR, DR, CT, MR and mammography.

label: Films & Media
tagline: Film and print media matched to the imager.
description: TRIMAX laser imaging film, ERAY medical and inkjet films, and SONY ultrasound print media for consistent diagnostic clarity.

label: Software & AI
tagline: From acquisition to archive to AI.
description: PACS, RIS, image acquisition software and partner AI platforms that connect every modality into one reporting workflow, including tele-radiology.

label: Accessories
description: Detector stands, carry bags, protection barriers, tables and radiology accessories built to integrate with existing radiography infrastructure.

label: Dental & Vision
description: Digital intraoral sensors for dental imaging and the AI-Optics handheld vision screener for early detection of refractive disorders.
